# install_lifecycle fixtures

Source trees used by `tests/kernel/packages/install_lifecycle_test.cpp`,
`asset_server_test.cpp`, and `crash_recovery_test.cpp` (all PG-gated
or `PLINTH_KERNEL_TESTS_ENABLED`-gated) to exercise ICD-0.4.4 cases
I.01–I.20.

Each subdirectory is an unpacked extension tree; the test driver zips
it on demand via `cmake -E tar --format=zip` (matches the production
zip-upload path) so the fixture on disk stays human-editable and
diff-reviewable.

| Fixture                       | Primary case | Notes                                              |
|-------------------------------|--------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| `valid-install/`              | I.01         | Shared with I.04, I.13, I.14, I.18, I.19, I.20.    |
| `valid-install-no-panels/`    | I.02         | `panels.json` removed.                             |
| `valid-install-frontend/`     | I.03         | `frontend.mount=/notes`; shell first-boot I.17.    |
| `missing-manifest/`           | I.08         | No `manifest.json` at root.                        |
| `fail-validator/`             | I.09         | `rbac.json` has an orphan namespace (CF1).         |
| `fail-migration/`             | I.10 / I.11  | `migrations/001_init.sql` has a SQL syntax error.  |
| `not-a-zip.bin`               | I.06         | File bytes, not a directory; POSTed raw.           |

Dynamic (generated by the test driver, no fixture on disk):

- I.05 oversized — a test-time zeroed buffer > 50 MB.
- I.07 path-traversal — a zip hand-crafted to contain `../evil.txt`.
- I.15 unknown route — no install at all, just a GET to a missing name.
- I.16 bundled-shell — uses the linker-embedded blob from `shell_blob.hpp`.
